title: Two-word exact polynomial dot products with cold precomputed powers

claims.statement: The analytic supplied-P pairing inversion algorithm in proof.md has success at least 0.39 under its sole disclosed SHA-256 idealization. Total cold work H+R/20000 is below 2^(3203/25) reference dense Fp12 equivalents, with H=K reference multiplications and R<=11072*K+2^90 other scalar instructions. Peak memory is below 2^50 bytes, advice zero. All preprocessing, trials, lookup, transfers, verification and G2 output are charged. This is an analytic heuristic bound, not a production execution.
